text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufun-fufun♪ Fufufufu-fun♪ ...Ehehe, 
Earth-san's singing is still stuck in my 
head.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
My, my, Kitasan. Your singing was simply 
wonderful, too. The bathhouse transformed 
into a concert hall in no time!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Dignified, yet carrying a traditional 
resonance... Yes, just like this... Like 
thiiis feeeeling aaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, w-wait...! Um... Y-You really should 
keep your voice down...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. My apologies! Just 
yesterday in the bath, I was scolded for 
being too loud!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Still, can you blame me? Caught between 
the voices of angels, anyone's spirits 
would soar.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Cheval-chan's humming was so cute~! 
Fluffy and light, it really does sound 
like angel wings!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, did you not realize? As you soaked in 
the tub, such a facilità melody reached my 
ears... softly intertwining—
